Moreover, the concept of contributory negligence cannot be imported to Section 3 of the 1923 Act, since it was not the intention of the Legislature itself to do so.

The only germane considerations are whether the victim was an employee, he died by accident and such accident arose out of and in the course of employment, all of which factors are satisfied in the present case.
